title: Compute the has/lacks differential and the route in kbfacts.pack
goal: kbfacts.pack returns `route` (None, `split` or `web`), `has` and `lacks` (the question's own words, not stems, in question order) and renders `route:`, `kb has:` and `kb lacks:` on weak, none and flagged good packs only, after the coverage, check:, freshness: and none sentence lines; pack_many adds one overall route line; _tools/test_route.py (class TestRoute) plants a weak, a none, a check-flagged good and a clean good question and asserts each pack's lines and their position.
notes: The flagged-good rule is gate `flagged` on ST-ysk3m7rt “kb_pack prints a route and what the kb has and lacks” (provisional: go on with its recommendation). Map stems back to the question's words the way kb_hook.respond does for none today. The check_line check passes now: it guards the existing tests that read `check:` on the pack's second line.
